subject.title: fix(anthropic): keep OAuth callback on loopback

question: Should Anthropic OAuth fail closed for non-loopback OPENCLAW_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST values while preserving the provider-facing localhost redirect URI?
rationale: The patch narrows an existing auth-provider environment surface and changes runtime failure behavior for custom callback-host setups, which needs maintainer security and compatibility intent beyond source inspection.

options.title: Accept After Real Proof
options.body: Require redacted current-head CLI/login-path evidence, then accept the loopback-only bind host and localhost redirect URI contract.

options.title: Require Stronger Provider Proof
options.body: Ask for live Anthropic or installed-client proof that localhost remains the required redirect URI across the allowed loopback bind hosts.

options.title: Pause Anthropic OAuth Direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer removing or redesigning the direct Anthropic OAuth helper instead of hardening this environment variable.

recommendation.title: Accept After Real Proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted current-head CLI/login-path evidence, then accept the loopback-only bind host and localhost redirect URI contract.
